reason: Ostrakon-VL adapts Qwen3-VL-8B with QUAD data curation and staged training for food-service/retail perception. The examined training, ShopBench evaluation and ablation sections compare task accuracy and parameter scales, without a concrete latency, memory or serving optimization.
title: Ostrakon-VL: Towards Domain-Expert MLLM for Food-Service and Retail Stores
